simple.meaning: מַחֲבֵא (machăbêʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a refuge.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַחֲבֵא (H4224) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Samuel 23:23, with occurrences in 1 Samuel, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַחֲבֵא (H4224) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַחֲבֵא (H4224) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַחֲבֵא (machăbêʼ) / H4224 is traced through 1 Samuel 23:23, Isaiah 32:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4224. machabe ' מַחֲבֵא noun [masculine] hiding-place , only construct זֶרֶם וְסֵתֶר רוּחַ כְּמַחֲבֵא Isa 32:2 hiding-place from wind. [ מַחֲבֹא ] noun [masculine] id., plural absolute שׁם יתחבא אשׁר הַמַּחֲבֹאִים מִכֹּל 1Sam 23:23 .

occurrences.englishText: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself, and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you. It shall happen, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.”
A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind,
